notes: SuperIdentityToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with EIP-2612 permit. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 SUPER with 18 decimals to msg.sender. Transfers move the full amount. The supply remains constant after construction. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
